newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain dismantles ETA car bomb squad, arrests two.
newsitem.headline: Spain dismantles ETA car bomb squad, arrests two.

text.p: Spain's Civil Guard have arrested two men suspected of belonging to a car bomb attack squad of ETA Basque separatist guerrillas, the Interior Ministry said on Friday.

The men, Igor Angulo, 23, and Kepa Zubizarreta, 25, were believed to be part of the ETA (Basque Homeland and Freedom) squad in the northern Navarre region that attacked a Civil Guard barracks with a car bomb on November 1, injuring five people.

They were arrested late on Thursday and a "sizeable" amount of explosives seized as a result of information from documents found when French police arrested an alleged ETA rebel leader in southwest France on Tuesday, a spokesman for the ministry said.

Interior Minister Jaime Mayor Oreja compared the police operation to the dismantling of a similar attack squad in Galicia in July and told journalists the arrests and seizure would "avert, without a doubt, blood and pain in Navarre".

"This commando was going to hit Navarre and the people of Navarre just as the Galicia commando in its time was going to do when it was stopped, and their arrest eliminates what would have been a nightmare for the future of Navarre," he said.
